name: humanize-robot-text
description: Rewrite machine-sounding text into the text of a busy human: cut 50-70% of the filler, break the even rhythm, remove robot vocabulary, keep every fact. Includes a strict short-message mode (DM) so a chat reply does not read as written by an AI. Use for posts, comments, follow-ups and outreach drafts before sending. Triggers: "humanize this", "remove AI slop", "sounds like a bot", "will they spot it's AI", "shorten and make it human".
